notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are supported. The two upper cabinet doors are reported separately because they are independently hinged parts, although their closing actions occur within the same 592–600 sampling interval. Camera movement around the open refrigerator from roughly frames 200–304 was not counted as another episode because the door does not show a clear stable closed-then-reopened cycle.
scene_description: A user moves through a compact kitchen and manipulates the refrigerator, two separate upper cabinet doors above the cooktop/range hood, and a top drawer beside the oven.
